result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main visible defect is in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the first two cards are identical duplicates (same name, image, time and delivery fee). A few minor contrast and consistency concerns also exist.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical cards, both 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same image, 15–25 min and €0.90 delivery. This looks like a duplicated data or rendering bug, and it wastes prime space in a short list.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list by unique ID before rendering, and check the backend or feed for repeated entries.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the light gray delivery fee lines ('€0.90 delivery'), the search placeholder, and the inactive tab labels has low contrast against the white or light gray backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA contrast of 4.5:1.

issues.description: The time badges on the carousel cards sit on the bottom-left edge of the image and overlap the image boundary tightly. The heart icon on the dark ramen image has a low-contrast translucent background. Both look slightly inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Give the badges consistent inset padding from the card edges, and use a more opaque or lighter background behind the favorite icon.

issues.description: The food images are flat illustrations rather than real photos, and the poké bowl image is small and off-center within its card. This makes the cards look like placeholders.
issues.suggestion: Use real, consistently cropped photography that fills the card.
